Hospitable | Senior Product Engineer (Laravel); Technical Support Engineer | REMOTE (EU / US up to East Coast) | Full-time | https://hospitable.com/careers

tldr; Software for Airbnbs to rent themselves. Remote-only (~122 people, 31 countries), bootstrapped & profitable, community-funded by hosts. Radical transparency, high trust / low bureaucracy — you're trusted, not managed. Culture: Humble, Simple, Caring, Democratic. Handbook: https://hsptb.com/hndbk

We're all-in on Laravel (non-negotiable for eng) — stack is PALM-B: PHP, Angular, Laravel, MySQL, Beanstalk. Very AI-first: ~90–95% of production code is AI-generated via Cursor and similar; a great seat for agentic engineers who can direct models, review hard, and own what ships.

Apply: https://apply.hospitable.com

Senior Product Engineer (Laravel) — Core & Growth REMOTE | EU or US East Coast timezones | $134,450–$167,258 total budget (COL-adjusted) | up to $76,026.50 $HOST RSUs | up to $380,895/yr Performance Share Units (PSUs; payout only when business targets hit — they don't time-vest) TLDR: Ship 0→1 on the Laravel monolith (properties, calendar, messaging, ops, growth) used by 25k+ hosts. 5+ yrs backend, deep Laravel/PHP/MySQL, hands-on agentic coding tools in a real production codebase. Apply: https://wrkbl.ink/6P8FU3Z

Technical Support Engineer (Americas/EMEA) REMOTE | US or EMEA timezones | $106,448–$133,106 total budget (COL-adjusted) | up to $48,402 $HOST RSUs | up to $273,628/yr PSUs TLDR: Bridge Support ↔ Engineering — build Laravel/Nova/Fin internal tools and AI support endpoints, automate workflows, dig into hard customer bugs across the product. PHP/Laravel product-eng experience required. Apply: https://wrkbl.ink/aVGzgxd

Please mention you found us via HN.
